body: Independent release review: actual v4.1.43 data plus a retained position, real Full Sync/resend helper, then real sync handler emitted Changed instead of New. Historical classification reconstructed deliberately cleared delivery state from the position journal. Four reset/resend combinations with/without seed markers seen red then green. Fixed c2a740bd96 by maintaining a current classification boundary and classifying before per-book clear; reading positions retained.

resolution.note: Four real tagged-database FullSync/resend cases seen red then green. Explicit recovery emits New while retaining positions; normal proven historical deliveries remain silent. Independent source/behavior verification recorded in docs/kobo-explicit-reset-upgrade-verification.md.

title: Explicit Kobo Full Sync and resend can be undone by historical position classification
